headline: HUAWEI teases nova 16s Series, hailing it as the 'King of Selfies'
snippet: Self-expression meets next-level smartphone innovation as HUAWEI unveils the nova 16s Series, arriving soon in the Philippines with prices starting at P29,999. Earning its title as the “King of AI Selfies,” the new lineup raises the bar in the front-facing camera experience by keeping skin tones true-to-color, preserving crystal-clear facial details, and providing smart AI-powered tools to effortlessly elevate every selfie. The HUAWEI nova Series Legacy Continues The HUAWEI nova Series has always focused on the vibrant self-expression of young people. Because it is designed for a generation that loves to create, curate, and share, HUAWEI dedicates its most advanced and cutting-edge front-facing selfie technology to the nova Series. By prioritizing these camera breakthroughs, the series continuously blends high-performance tech with trendsetting fashion DNA to match the confident lifestyle of today's youth. This year, the legacy continues with the HUAWEI nova 16s Series, reinforcing its position as the “King of AI Selfies” with its latest innovations in mobile photography. Featuring Front and Rear True-to-Colour Cameras, a 200MP main camera, and reliable 5G connectivity, the series helps users capture every moment in stunning detail. Its smart AI imaging tools, including AI Composition and AI Move, make it easier to enhance photos. King of AI Selfies with Front and Rear True-to-Color Cameras Whether vlogging at a weekend music festival, capturing outfit photos under bright sunlight, or snapping memories during late-night hangouts, the HUAWEI nova 16s Pro’s powerful dual front camera system helps users capture true colors as they appear in real life. HUAWEI’s exclusive Front True-to-Color Camera is equipped with a 1.5 MP multispectral sensor and pixel-level spectral perception algorithms to actively detect ambient color temperatures. This reproduces colors more naturally across tricky lighting situations like neon concert lights or harsh midday sun, improving color accuracy by 120% and spatial resolution by 100,000x to eliminate distortion and keep skin tones and makeup true to life. Along with the 50MP Ultra Portrait Camera, the HUAWEI nova 16s Pro also features a 1/2.5-inch ultra-large front camera sensor that captures significantly more light. This ensures exceptional clarity during nighttime parties or dimly lit dinners while preserving natural facial details. Finally, this 50MP Ultra Portrait Camera introduces the industry’s first 0.8x–5x Selfie Zoom, giving users flexibility to capture everything, from ultra-wide group shots with the entire squad to detailed close-up selfies that show off their eye makeup or accessories. On the back, the HUAWEI nova 16s Pro boasts a powerful four-camera system that elevates everyday photography. This quad-camera setup introduces a dedicated Rear True-to-Color Camera that enhances the color accuracy of all the other rear lenses. Thanks to this integration, users can be confident that their photos will always show their true colors with authentic, natural skin tones, whether they are shooting portraits from the front or the rear cameras. Anchoring this setup is a flagship-level 200MP RYYB Ultra-Large Sensor Main Camera with a 1/1.28-inch sensor and F1.8 aperture to capture more light and produce clearer photos in low-light conditions. Users can also crop photos of distant concert stages or travel destinations while keeping important details clear. The HUAWEI nova 16s Series makes photography and editing effortless for young creators using smart AI tools. AI Composition serves as a built-in photography assistant, offering real-time guidance on lighting, perspective, and subject positioning to help make every photo feed-ready. AI Move enables users to reposition subjects in a frame, while AI Remove erases photobombers and background clutter with seamless color blending. For shots taken through reflective surfaces, AI De-Glare sweeps away distracting reflections. Finally, AI Best Expression scans multiple captures to swap and select everyone's best facial look, so no one is caught blinking in group photos. Powerful Performance & All-Day Durability For young professionals on the move, the HUAWEI nova 16s Series delivers a smarter, seamless mobile experience powered by robust 5G. This advanced connectivity enables significantly faster upload and download speeds for uploading heavy vlogs and high-resolution photos or lag-free online gaming. The optimized 5G network also ensures instant signal recovery when entering or leaving an elevator, while maintaining stable connections in weak-signal areas such as basement parking lots. Powered by an upgraded IceBridge Heat Dissipation Architecture, the HUAWEI nova 16s Series delivers smoother gameplay and boosted performance for high-demand activities. The HUAWEI nova 16s Series takes endurance further with a massive 7,000mAh battery and 100W HUAWEI SuperCharge Turbo, topping up to 40% in just 15 minutes. Its vibrant 6.84-inch display features an adaptive 1-120Hz refresh rate and up to 6,000 nits peak brightness, ensuring razor-sharp clarity whether under direct sunlight or reviewing photos. Wave-Inspired Aesthetics Built for Everyday Adventures The HUAWEI nova 16s Pro balances everyday durability with a striking visual identity. Built for peace of mind during daily commutes or outdoor travels, the device features an aerospace-grade aluminum mid-frame and durable Kunlun Glass. This specialized glass utilizes an advanced nanocrystal coating to deliver 10x higher drop resistance and 5x higher wear resistance than the previous generation. This durability is packed into an ultra-slim 7.1 mm, 218 g body with a fingerprint-free Frosted AG Glass back. Inspired by summer skies and rolling waves, its soft icy-blue matte finish and upgraded Twin Star Orbit Ring catch shifting light with a subtle, soothing shimmer. Users can express their personal style with the HUAWEI nova 16s Pro in Breathing Crystal, Isle Blue, and Starry Black colorways. The HUAWEI nova 16s is available in Breathing Crystal, Starry Black, and Sky White. Intelligent and Seamless Ecosystem Equipped with the latest EMUI 16, the HUAWEI nova 16s Series makes everyday tasks easier and more intuitive. Users can take advantage of the enhanced Celia AI Assistant, which responds to voice commands, answers knowledge-based questions, and helps book a ride hands-free. It also introduces Seamless Cross-OS File Transfer that allows users to share files and high-resolution photos between the HUAWEI nova 16s Series and Apple devices, like the iPhone, iPad, and MacBook. For everyday tasks, the HUAWEI AppGallery delivers a smooth and reliable app experience, allowing users to access go-to apps like Gcash, BDO, Shopee, and Grab, and explore Google essentials like Gmail, YouTube, Drive, Meet, and Docs. Experience the Most Powerful nova Series Ever The HUAWEI nova 16s Series delivers a fresh take on the youthful flagship experience. Official pre-orders open on October 30, offering the HUAWEI nova 16s at a promo price of P29,999 and the HUAWEI nova 16s Pro at P39,999, giving early buyers a limited-time P5,000 discount. All pre-orders include a premium gift bundle worth up to P14,997. An exclusive deposit promo runs on the official HUAWEI Online Store from October 23 (10:00 AM) to October 29 (11:59 PM), where a PHP 500 deposit grants a P6,000 discount. Early buyers on Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop can claim a P5,000 voucher. Early bird vouchers and promos are limited, so claim now before they are gone. To celebrate the upcoming launch, HUAWEI invites everyone to join the TikTok #TrueColorsSelfieChallenge starting October 23. Using the exclusive HUAWEI nova 16s Series Branded Effect, capture your true colors and post your selfie video using the hashtags #TrueColorsSelfieChallenge, #HUAWEInova16sSeries, and #KingOfAISelfies. With a total prize pool worth P2,249,950, the top 50 users with the highest views will win a brand-new HUAWEI nova 16s Pro.

snippet: Colombian packaging business Impreac – Impresos y Acabados has invested in an Edale CartonLine FL5, agreed at Loupe Americas 2026, and will become Edale's reference site in Colombia and the wider Latin American market. 'The FL5 is an investment in the future of our folding carton business. We have ambitions to develop the business further, and we wanted a platform that could grow with us and respond to changing customer requirements,' said Luis Fernando Herrera Salinas, production director at Impreac. 'Our decision was also about the partnership behind the technology. We have built a strong relationship with Edale through this process, and becoming a reference customer in Colombia is something we are very proud of.' 'The significance of this project goes beyond the installation of one machine. Impreac has clear ambitions, and as a reference customer in Colombia, it gives us the opportunity to demonstrate Edale technology in a market where we see significant potential,' explained Rob Brown, sales and marketing director at Edale. 'Intermarket played an important role in bringing the project together, and the relationship we have developed through the Impreac deal gives us a stronger foundation from which to build our presence in Latin America.' headline: USDA confirms New World screwworm in Texas elk
snippet: The U. S. Department of Agriculture has identified the first instance of New World screwworm in a wild animal within the United States, confirming the presence of the parasitic fly in an elk in Texas. The detection, announced Wednesday, marks a significant expansion of the parasite's range in North America, extending beyond livestock into the broader wildlife ecosystem and introducing new considerations for public health surveillance and veterinary response. The affected elk was discovered on a game ranch in Pecos County after being harvested by a hunter. Upon inspection, the animal showed signs consistent with infestation, prompting a report to the USDA's Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service. This finding triggered immediate public health actions: the USDA and the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department initiated additional wildlife surveillance in the region, while the Texas Animal Health Commission is modifying previously established infested zones to reflect the new data. These measures aim to contain the spread among susceptible species and monitor for potential human exposure. New World screwworm is a parasitic fly that lays eggs in the open wounds or natural body openings of warm-blooded animals. Once the eggs hatch, the larvae feed on living tissue, causing severe damage. While the USDA notes that the parasite does not compromise food safety, it can significantly impact meat production by rendering tissue unsuitable for consumption. The parasite is typically native to South America and parts of the Caribbean, but it has progressively spread north into Central America and Mexico in recent years. Its arrival in the U. S. represents a continuation of this northward migration, with the first confirmed case in a U. S. animal being a three-week-old Texas calf in June of this year, and the first human case confirmed last year. That human patient recovered fully, and officials determined there was no evidence of further transmission.
